name: apis.io agent skills
description: Skills for discovering and consuming APIs in the apis.io federated catalog — navigate the network, search the catalog, fetch specs, onboard providers, and (Pro) design, shortlist, audit, and monitor API stacks.

skills.name: discover-apis-io
skills.description: Discover the structure of the apis.io network — its subdomains, machine-readable catalogs, and content-negotiation conventions — so other skills can find APIs efficiently.

skills.name: search-apis
skills.description: Find APIs in the apis.io catalog by keyword, capability, tag, or provider.

skills.name: fetch-api-spec
skills.description: Given an apis.io API URL or catalog entry, fetch the OpenAPI / AsyncAPI / Postman specification for that API.

skills.name: find-api
skills.description: Find the right API for a task — search the catalog, inspect the best candidates, and recommend one with its spec and links.

skills.name: integrate-provider
skills.description: Onboard a provider end-to-end — read its onboarding and OpenAPI from the catalog and produce concrete first-integration steps.

skills.name: discover-mcp-servers
skills.description: Find providers in the catalog that publish a public MCP server, so you can plug real tools into an agent.

skills.name: assemble-api-stack
skills.description: Pro — Design a capability stack from the catalog and export it as an adoptable APIs.json a team can commit.

skills.name: shortlist-vendors
skills.description: Pro — Turn a single capability into a scored, compared vendor shortlist with a clear recommendation.

skills.name: audit-api-estate
skills.description: Pro — Inventory, score, and gap a set of providers: what they publish, how they rate, and what they're missing.

skills.name: track-api-changes
skills.description: Pro — Monitor the catalog for providers added/updated and rating movement, for a chosen set or the whole network.
